description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Cleanup, which extends a decorator class to add cache cleanup functionality when cache misses occur. It provides methods to copy, add, set, replace, and get cached definitions, ensuring cache cleanup is triggered on failure.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_DefinitionCache_Decorator_Cleanup
classes.description: A cache decorator class that cleans up the cache on a miss during add, set, replace, or get operations.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of the cleanup decorator.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a definition to the cache; if it fails, triggers cache cleanup.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a definition in the cache; if it fails, triggers cache cleanup.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a definition in the cache; if it fails, triggers cache cleanup.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a definition from the cache; if it fails, triggers cache cleanup.
